details.report: Committed the three authorized code classes in forward commit 227b558. The Assisted Runner locator now delegates canonical UUIDv7 validation to isUuidV7; the AssistedCall validator's dense subject/acquisition/execution/path/provenance locals are domain-named without contract changes; and snapshot freshness now normalizes capturedAt only, so parent/child tracker observation-time drift invalidates prior Navigator advice. Added public locator coverage, digest/binding coverage, and a production lifecycle regression proving observation-time-only prelaunch drift reconsults before role launch. Rebuilt assisted/recorder distributions. Verification passed: focused red/green tests, npm test (373 passed, 5 skipped), npm run typecheck, npm run build:recorder, and git diff --check. No findings were declined; Soul prose and role topology were untouched.
